purpose: Paired retrieval ablation; not legal-answer acceptance
returned_evidence: Complete parent articles for every strategy; no child-only citation shortcuts
selection_policy: Choose a candidate on the disclosed 32-case regression set before opening new holdout results. Require no scope/status regression, no loss of required evidence, and a quality gain to justify remote latency. Keep default baseline unless promotion has sufficient evidence. Do not tune after holdout failures.
precision_warning: Target-only precision treats only oracle targets as positive; it is not exhaustive relevance labeling.

ragas.selection: Same disclosed diagnostic sample as prior run, not representative or a blind set
ragas.comparison: Rescore baseline and chosen candidate with the same judge, references, and budgets. Never interpret a judge-only change as a retrieval improvement.

deferred_reason: Test the least complex independent mechanisms first; add a new mechanism only after evidence of an unmet error class.
